public_rationale: The graded part is that OpenAI 'burns billions of dollars'. The clause about having no path to profit is hedged ('does not appear') and is not scored. CNBC confirmed from company documents that OpenAI expected to lose about $5 billion in 2024 on $3.7 billion in revenue. That is billions of dollars lost in the latest full year before the post. A later Reuters report says OpenAI burned $2.5 billion in cash in the first half of 2025, which fits the claim. The burn part holds.
limitations: The 2024 loss figure comes from news reports of company documents, made before the year ended. It is not audited.
The figure excludes equity-based compensation, so the true accounting loss was probably larger, not smaller.
The profit-path clause was not graded.

Target period: the claim describes an ongoing state at 2025-04-28. The latest full year public reporting covered before the post is calendar 2024, so that is the period used. This is my choice.
criteria.support_condition: Credible reporting shows OpenAI's annual loss or cash burn for 2024 was in the billions of dollars.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible reporting shows OpenAI's 2024 loss or cash burn was below $1 billion, or that it was profitable.
